cases.sentence: Отправьте сражаться по тысяче мужчин из каждого ___.
cases.explain: «израильского рода» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

cases.sentence: Израильтяне взяли в плен мадианских женщин и детей и взяли в добычу все ___, отары и их имущество.
cases.explain: «мадианские стада» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

cases.sentence: На третий и на ___ очистите себя и пленников.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

cases.sentence: В ___ выстирайте одежду и вы будете чисты.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

cases.sentence: Раздели добычу между воинами, которые были в битве, и ___.
cases.explain: «остальным народом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

cases.sentence: Начальники над ___ — тысячники и сотники — пришли к Моисею 49 и сказали ему:
cases.explain: «войсковыми подразделениями» — after the preposition «над», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
